proposal.reason: Main substantive change is to open-source test workflow execution: dual-platform (M890P + OAM-810E) case generation/grouping, CI matrices and node/rack allocation policy, optional trusted HPN SDK install plumbing, expanded native-unit/PR-daily selections, and reconciliation/reporting artifact handling (including raw/dmesg logs and metadata). Modified scripts/docs/tests support this CI behavior change rather than contributor-review policy or runtime PCCL modules.
